messages.text: Fan upgrade for thor p2
Searched the catalog · fan upgrade Thor P2 cooling fan accessory
Read the hammer miner thor p2 page
Searched the catalog · fan

We don't sell a fan upgrade kit for the Thor P2. It's a sealed unit, fan plus heatsink, about 40 dB and 166 W stock, so it's already one of the quieter and cooler-running boxes we carry. Swapping the fan yourself counts as a modification and would drop warranty cover, so I'd leave it alone.

What usually makes a P2 louder is dust in the intake. If that's what you're chasing, the Miner Duster at $39.99 keeps the mesh and fins clear.

Is it noise or heat you're trying to fix?
Dont like rgb in fans, it loses performance. Would like to swap the stock fan with a noctua

Fair enough, but I'd hold off. Opening the case to change the fan counts as a modification, and that ends warranty and RMA cover on the unit, even if the Noctua runs better.

I also won't guess the fan size, connector or PWM curve on the P2, since the listing only says fan plus heatsink. Let me get JD, who handles the hardware, to give you the exact fan spec so you know what you'd be dealing with before you decide.

What's your email so he can reach you?
Its not in a case

You're right, my mistake, the P2 is open frame, no case to open.

Doesn't change the warranty side though: a fan that isn't the one it shipped with counts as a modification, so a later RMA on that unit would be declined. Some people accept that trade for the quiet. Your call.

Either way, JD can tell you the stock fan's size, connector and whether it's PWM, so a Noctua would actually work. Drop me your email and I'll put it to him.
(email hidden)
Handed to the team · Fan size, connector and PWM spec are not in the product data; hardware question

Got it, JD has it now, with the question being the stock fan's size, connector and whether it's PWM so you can match a Noctua. Stay in the chat and he'll jump in here. If you step away, the answer comes to (email hidden)
Ok thank you
Used the chat-interview skill
Before you go, one thing: what made you want a different fan before the unit has even run?
Dont
Understood, no worries. JD will be in touch about the fan spec.
Would rather performance than rgb lighting
That's fair, and I'd want the same. I'll make sure JD knows that's the reason, so he tells you airflow and static pressure on the stock fan rather than just the size.
Ok
All set then. Stay in the chat if you can and JD will pick it up here, otherwise it comes to your email.
Ok
Thanks for your patience. I'll leave you to it.
